posts.title: Why AI Didn't Cite Your Site in Search Results
posts.text:
I asked an AI for the best whey protein in India.

The legacy brands showed up. The viral protein sponsor of India's Got Latent, despite millions of views, did not.

The top pick was the brand that wrote the answer page. Its own site had a 2,000+ word breakdown titled around the exact query, with comparison tables and an FAQ, and that page became the AI's #1 source.

Why this matters: Pew found that when Google shows an AI summary, people click a regular search result 8% of the time, versus 15% without one. If the AI answer doesn't name you, most people never reach you. That's what GEO is…
